Name: Social Scrapbook
Author: Cpdncristiano
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I play Stardew Valley with many mods, so my game has grown to include a large number of NPCs. With so many characters, stories and events happening at the same time, I often find myself forgetting important details about them.

Sometimes I meet an NPC, learn something interesting about their story, or make a personal decision related to that character. Later, when I meet them again, I cannot remember exactly what happened or what I wanted to do next. I always wished I had a simple place inside the game where I could write everything down.

When I discovered [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49525]Parchment[/url], created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PeacefulEnd]PeacefulEnd[/url], I really liked the idea of interactive books and started thinking about creating my own personal journal.

Social Scrapbook was created to solve this problem. It gives every villager a place inside an interactive journal where you can write your own notes, observations, reminders, story details, roleplay ideas, future plans, or anything else you want to remember.

Alongside your personal notes, the journal helps organize useful information about each villager, including birthdays, relationships and known gifts. You can also mark favorite villagers and use the search feature to quickly find a specific character, which can be especially helpful when playing with large NPC expansions.

You can open Social Scrapbook through its physical book or by pressing the N key. This shortcut can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu.

The mod currently uses the Stardew Valley Lost Book sprite as a temporary icon until I can create an original one. Pixel art is not my strongest skill, but I hope to create a custom sprite for the journal in the future.

I created this mod to make my own heavily modded game easier to follow, and I hope it can help other players who also enjoy large worlds filled with characters and stories. I hope you enjoy it.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
[list]
[*]Write and save personal notes for every villager.
[*]Record story details, reminders, observations and future plans.
[*]Browse villager profiles, birthdays and social information.
[*]View known gifts and relationships.
[*]Mark favorite villagers for quick access.
[*]Find specific villagers through the built in search.
[*]Open the journal through its physical book or with the N key.
[*]Configure the shortcut through Generic Mod Config Menu.
[*]Navigate through an interactive parchment style journal.
[/list][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49525]Parchment[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PeacefulEnd]PeacefulEnd[/url] is required.
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and allows you to configure the shortcut used to open the journal.
[/list][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PeacefulEnd]PeacefulEnd[/url] for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49525]Parchment[/url], the library that made this interactive journal possible.

UI artwork is based on the licensed [url=https://pixel-vault.itch.io/pixel-book-ui-v1]Book UI V1 asset pack by Pixel Vault[/url].[/color][/size]
